messages.subject: WC-00115 - claim issued today
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Gordon,

We issued the Claim Form in the Circuit Commercial Court this morning. The claim number is CC-2025-LON-000389. The total claimed is £1,099,250 plus interest and costs (£487,250 unpaid invoices and £612,000 damages for wrongful termination).

The Particulars of Claim, settled by Harriet Stanford of counsel, will be served shortly. We'll keep you updated.

Best regards,
Tom

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
